summary: 22 of 27 targets promoted to exact per-episode records; the 5 novel-only Itachi Shinden episodes (452-454, 456-457) are recorded as zone_level_only with evidence that they adapt no manga pages at all. Primary source is the Narutopedia episode-infobox `chapters=` field (fetched via the MediaWiki API), cross-checked against animefillerguide's full 500-row episode-to-chapter table — the two agree everywhere, but their lists are identical enough to suspect shared lineage, so every zone was additionally corroborated with genuinely independent evidence: Wikipedia chapter-title matches (ch 312 'The Impending Menace!!' = ep 72's title, ch 314 'The Akatsuki Strikes...!!' = ep 73, ch 410 'The Battle at Storm Cloud Ravine' = ep 142 'Battle of Unraikyo', ch 556 'Steam Imp!!' = ep 302, ch 467 'Declaration of War' = ep 205), Wikipedia's statement that the Kakashi Gaiden is chapters 239-244, volume-summary content, and episode synopses. Surprises: the wind-training early pass skips ch 313 entirely (first adapted in ep 72), the 72-74 re-cover pass only re-runs 312-314 + 318-319 (315-317 exist on screen only inside the filler-framed eps 55-56), ep 300 carries a sliver of ch 548 (the Gaara-side panels of the 'Naruto vs. Itachi' chapter), the war-rotation zone actually extends to ch 558, and ep 455 is disputed between a ch-678 Infinite-Tsukuyomi frame cutback (Narutopedia) and pure novel content (animefillerguide) — recorded as a medium anchor. No stored anchors needed repair.

flags_for_sean: Source-independence caveat: the Narutopedia infobox chapter lists and animefillerguide's table agree verbatim on every row checked (including odd entries like ep 300's 548), so they likely share lineage; every anchor was therefore additionally corroborated with Wikipedia chapter-title matches, volume summaries, and episode synopses, noted per anchor.

Ep 455 'Moonlit Night': Narutopedia lists ch 678 (its summary opens on the Team-7-under-Susanoo frame), animefillerguide says NOVEL-only. Recorded as a medium anchor with the 678 frame; if you prefer symmetry with the other mid-block novel eps, demote to zone_level/novel-only.

Eps 460-461: Narutopedia ties both to ch 681 (Black Zetsu narration frame), animefillerguide calls both filler, animefillerlist keeps them Mixed Canon/Filler. Recorded as medium 681-frame anchors per the stored 'ch 681 stretched across four eps' annotation.

Ep 300's chapter set includes a ch-548 sliver ('Naruto vs. Itachi' chapter — its Gaara-side panels). Both sources list it and the synopsis supports it (the interrupted sealing cold open), but it is the softest fragment in the batch; the whole 299-302 rotation zone has shared boundary chapters and soft continue points (300's continue 553 is a judgment call).

Type-correction vocabulary: 452-454/456-457 proposed as anime-only-canon (novel-only) against animefillerlist's 'Mixed Canon/Filler' — your call whether novel adaptations count as mixed or anime-only-canon in our taxonomy.

Wind-zone continue convention: eps 55-56 get continue 313 (the skipped Hidan/Kakuzu chapter) rather than end+1 — the early pass leaves 313 as the first unread chapter until ep 72 covers it; sanity-check this against how the renderer surfaces continue points inside non-monotonic zones.
